blockers.required_evidence: All scoped artifacts built twice from the RC, immutable digests/checksums, SBOMs, provenance, and authenticated registry publication.
Complete production-equivalent service topology deployed exclusively by RC digests with commit endpoints and healthy dependencies.
Trusted exact-name SAN coverage for every nested production hostname, including NovaPay, NovaRide, and NovaLogistics APIs.
Secret, SAST, dependency, image, DAST, authorization, and qualified manual penetration results with zero unresolved Critical or High findings.
Deployed RC API and browser journeys across required products and browser matrix.
Signed Rider and Driver artifacts tested on required physical Android and iOS devices.
Approved provider tests including signing, replay, outage, reconciliation, and settlement controls.
Predeclared SLOs and passing deployed baseline, peak, burst, concurrency, and soak results.
Executed backup restore, rollback, failover and DR with measured RPO/RTO.
End-to-end telemetry and completed critical alert drills with routing and resolution timelines.
Deterministic manifest signed and verified by an approved organisational identity.
Explicit RC and manifest-bound approvals from every mandatory reviewer.
